ReverseProxy.description: Settings of the forwarded headers processing, used when the application is hosted behind a reverse proxy. These values override the ones configured in the admin settings, and they are only applied when the 'ConfigureReverseProxySettings()' extension method is called on the OrchardCoreBuilder. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/ReverseProxy/.

ForwardedHeaders.description: The forwarded headers to process, as a comma-separated combination of 'None', 'XForwardedFor', 'XForwardedHost', 'XForwardedProto', 'XForwardedPrefix' and 'All', e.g. 'XForwardedFor, XForwardedProto'.

KnownNetworks.description: The networks of the proxies that forwarded headers are accepted from, in CIDR notation.

items.description: A network in CIDR notation, e.g. '10.0.0.0/8'.

KnownProxies.description: The IP addresses of the proxies that forwarded headers are accepted from.

OrchardCore_ReverseProxy.deprecationMessage: The 'OrchardCore_ReverseProxy' section is deprecated. Use 'OrchardCore:ReverseProxy' instead.
